notes:
Lead: Verdant Copilot Labs — large engineering org building a first-party IDE copilot and embedded code-assistant. Primary goal: ship low-latency completions inside internal IDE with predictable per-seat economics.

Key requirements / snippets from calls:
- "Need sub-50ms token completions for local developer flows when running on dedicated pools; 90th perc p95 <= 120ms for streaming." — VP Eng
- Must support model/version pinning per team (stable pin for critical services, fast-channel for experimental features).
- Cost targets: reduce per-seat inference cost by 3x vs current hosted baseline through batching + prefix/KV caching + 4-bit quantized variants. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations.
- Deployment: hybrid — dedicated in cloud for most teams, air-gapped on-prem for regulated finance unit. SSO/SAML required, KMS integration for key material. Audit logging + 7y retention for some audit trails.
- Workloads: heavy interactive code completion (websocket streaming), bulk embedding pipelines for semantic code search (nightly), and reranking for PR suggestions. Need autoscaling that preserves latency SLOs.

POC scope being negotiated:
- Phase 1 (2 weeks): run latency & throughput benchmarks for streaming completions using team internal prompts; validate model pinning + seamless fallback to lower-cost variants.
- Phase 2 (4 weeks): quantization pilot (4-bit LLM) on Dedicated pool + measure quality regression vs fp16; integrate prefix KV cache to measure token savings.
- Success metrics: cost per active seat (USD/month) < $3.50 for core dev team at target throughput; p95 latency <= 120ms for completion stream; embedding pipeline throughput >= 1500 embeds/sec for nightly jobs.

Quotes & shorthand:
- "If we can't model-pin reliably we can't launch enterprise-wide; dev leads need predictability."
- "Show us before/after unit-econ dashboard: tokens saved, cost per call, tail latency."

Stakeholders: CTO (product requirements), Head of Infra (on-prem), Security Manager (SAML/KMS), Procurement (contract).

Open asks / clarifications:
- Clear mapping of per-seat billing model vs tokens — how to report per-seat cost for showback?
- Quantization profile recommendations per model family and expected perf deltas.
- Guidance on cache TTLs and eviction for developer-focused prefix caching.

Files: pricing deck + security FAQ shared (drive links). Fireflies and thread ids above. Proc timeline expected by end of Q1 2026.
